[LLSU.9.1] The cache plane, per [LSTO]. The facts and
samples planes, and hydration, are deferred ([LSTO.2], [LSTO.3], [LHYD.1]).

| Name | Explanation | Dependencies | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cached` | `let v = cached("k")` — sync-intent read (let-RHS expression per LGRA.9.8.2) | | not generally avoidable as a sync-read primitive |
| `cache` | `cache key: k value: v` — async write | | keep the state in a `logical` fact |
| `cache_delete` | `cache_delete key: k` | | let TTL expire the key (may be too slow) |
| `cache_ttl` | `ttl: <dur>` on `cache` | `cache` | manage invalidation via explicit delete |
